description: Use this to answer "what does this agency actually buy, and from whom?" before a first call: total contract obligations, 3-year trend, top 10 vendors, and top 10 NAICS categories for the latest fiscal year with published data. Good queries name one agency, e.g. agency="HHS". Figures come from a daily snapshot of USAspending (latest published fiscal year plus a 3-year trend); the fiscal year and freshness are stated in the response. Federal only. Read the coverage caveats — in-progress fiscal years are partial, and intel-agency spend is never published.

agency.description: Federal agency name, acronym, or code — e.g. "HHS", "Department of Veterans Affairs", "075".

name: agency_spend_profile
title: Profile a federal agency's contract spending
